title: Reminders
desc: Set when and how you receive alerts
masterSwitchDesc: Turn all reminders on or off
masterOffHint: Reminders are disabled. No alerts will be scheduled.
categorySectionDesc: Alerts by content type. Each category has its own advance time.
checkTimeDesc: Get a daily alert when you have cards due for review.
defaultOffsetDesc: Applies to categories without their own advance time
quietHoursDesc: No reminders are generated within this window
resetDefaultsBody: The advance times for all categories and the quiet hours will be restored. Changes apply immediately.

infoBody1: Reminders are created automatically. You don't need to configure them here manually.
infoBody2: When you add an assessment, a calendar event, a class schedule, or a flashcard deck, Threshold's engine automatically schedules alerts based on the advance time you configured for each category.
infoBody3: This screen is just an observability window so you can see how many alerts the system has scheduled for you and when.
